scope: Desktop-only reversible diagnostic of unexplained registered RAF waits; artificial native-ABI joystick. No phone, production GPU-setting change, deployment, or presumed GPU root cause.

proposal.difference: Only B appends --disable-gpu-vsync to both owned Chrome processes. All groups must exclude --disable-frame-rate-limit and reject assigned variants/duplicates.

constants.transport: Independent relay input lane 39±5 ms; no additional burst, no drop
constants.graphics: Existing normal Windows Chrome, Intel UHD/ANGLE D3D11

acceptance.launch: Both actual owned browser argv observed and verified, unique PIDs, same executable identity; A lacks flag, B has exactly the bare flag, no frame-rate-disable variants
acceptance.run: Complete native frontier body, actual route, valid touch with all denominators, ordered peer hashes through 1200, lifecycle/trace coverage qualified
acceptance.effect: Compare registered RAF wait, native callback wall, new-state RAF and Page gap tails, conditional input response, pacing and GPU/compositor evidence; argv alone does not prove runtime effect
acceptance.failure: Retain all failures, incomplete traces, endpoint/teardown distinctions and adverse samples. Do not infer a fix from one good B if the A groups do not reproduce the issue.
acceptance.limits: Independent input clocks, source tapes, background execution and window exposure can differ. Setup/end window snapshots are not continuous foreground or physical scanout proof.

status: Predeclared; driver implementation and all experiment runs pending
